scope: Intermediate docking diagnosis. This scheduler ticked field decisions at 52 Hz with measured poses delayed about 58 ms. ROS ownership and camera guard transport were modeled in this earlier probe. The principal qualification uses the real 50 Hz field cadence and the production body-command guard.
interpretation: One short speed-floor pulse after sustained near-target standstill recovered this particular initial pose. At production cadence the same offset left start also reaches the ball unassisted. These two simulated timelines do not establish a real-robot deadband.
